questionStem: 2. Identify the following sets as finite or infinite.

parts.exactEnglish: X = The set of all districts in Tamilnadu.
Y = The set of all straight lines passing through a point.
A = { x : x ∈ Z and x <5}

mathematicalNotes: Q2(i): avoid a fixed district count, since administrative boundaries can change.
Q2(ii): infinitely many directions through a point.
Q2(iii): integers below 5 have no lower bound.
Q2(iv): x²−5x+6=(x−2)(x−3); both roots are natural.
